title: Prerequisite / concept dependency DAG: CI-validated and published as learner map
context: PLAN.md v0.2 commits to an explicit prerequisite / concept dependency graph (DAG) across lessons — for example, data frames + factors must precede DESeq2 design formulas. The DAG must be: (a) committed in machine-readable form, (b) validated in CI so lesson ordering can never silently violate a prerequisite, and (c) published as the learner's roadmap on the curriculum site. This is an M0 exit criterion per PLAN.md v0.2 and depends on the front-matter schema (objectives-012) whose 'prerequisites' field provides the per-lesson edges.
objective: Implement the prerequisite / concept dependency DAG: a committed machine-readable graph (derived from the 'prerequisites' fields in each lesson's front-matter), a CI validation step that detects cycles and prerequisite violations, and a generated learner-facing map (e.g., a Mermaid diagram or JSON rendered to the static site) published on the curriculum site.
acceptanceCriteria: A CI step reads the 'prerequisites' field from every lesson's front-matter (per the schema in objectives-012), builds the DAG, and fails the build if any cycle is detected or if a referenced lesson id does not exist.
A CI step fails if any lesson's module placement violates its declared prerequisites (e.g., a lesson in M1 that depends on a lesson from M2).
A committed machine-readable DAG artefact (e.g., dag.json or dag.yml) is generated and checked in or generated in CI for the site build.
A learner-facing prerequisite map (Mermaid diagram or equivalent) is generated and published to the curriculum site or docs/ directory.
